text: Alright, okay... I guess I understand why you need the order number. Yeah, transferring me to someone else might be a better idea. Maybe they can help me find it faster or figure out what's going on. Sounds good, thanks for trying.
zh: 好吧，好的...我猜我明白为什么需要订单号。是的，把我转接给其他人可能是个更好的主意。也许他们能帮我更快地找到它，或者弄清楚是怎么回事。听起来不错，谢谢您的努力。
